svg.title: Model Selection Decision Framework
svg.desc: Decision tree starting from the task type. If the task runs on the edge or embedded, use Phi-3 or Phi-3.5. If not, ask the reasoning depth: deep reasoning uses GPT-4o or the o1-series. For standard reasoning, ask the latency priority: low latency uses GPT-4o-mini or Phi-3-mini, and balanced uses GPT-4o.
svg.text: Ask the questions in order; stop at the first answer that fits.
